prompts: Words are tied to each other, and nobody here can see how. {WS}/site is a saved copy of a Portuguese creative dictionary. Explore this universe of words: collect what the site knows and build {WS}/universe/index.html, a single file that sums the universe up in one view and lets someone search for a word and find how it relates to others. The best way to show it is your call, and that view is what we care about most. So people can share a word, opening the page with ?word=saudade must show that word and its relations. Save the data as {WS}/words.json, mapping each word to the words it is linked to, and record in {WS}/result.json: words (how many), relations (how many distinct pairs) and most_connected. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] Extract the word-link universe from ./site and ship a single-file searchable view at ./universe/index.html plus words.json and result.json.

[action] Parsed all 256 pages with a script (extract.py): word pages are those with a `<main><h1>` plus Sinônimos/Palavras análogas sections; index/sobre/contato excluded; meta-refresh stubs (saudades→saudade, corações→coração, paixões→paixão) resolved; percent-encoded hrefs decoded; dead targets (rascunho-3, xpto-2, em-construcao, link-antigo, pagina-removida) dropped. Built a 3D force-directed graph (three.module.js from the allowed jsdelivr URL, Fraunces/Sora from Google Fonts): nodes colored by the site's 10 temas, sized by degree; drag to rotate, wheel zoom, click or search (accent- and case-insensitive, "cafe" finds "café") to focus a word, highlight its edges and dim the rest; a side panel lists its relations as clickable chips; the URL updates to ?word=… and opening with ?word=saudade preselects it. Data is embedded inline because file:// blocks fetch of a sibling JSON.

[result] words.json: 250 words → their linked words. result.json: `{"words": 250, "relations": 743, "most_connected": "palavra"}`. Verified in a real browser: ?word=saudade shows saudade centered with 5 labeled neighbors (ansiedade, carinho, dor, esperança, nostalgia) matching site/saudade.html; search "cafe" → café, URL becomes ?word=caf%C3%A9, relations match site/Cafe.html. Counts re-derived by a second, independent HTMLParser-based script: 250 words, 743 distinct undirected pairs, max degree 16.

Assumptions: relations are undirected pairs from the union of both sections (743); most_connected is a tie between "palavra" and "tempo" (both 16) — reported alphabetically first; footer/aside/nav links are decoration, not relations.

[next] Nothing required; open universe/index.html directly. Optional: show both tied hubs if a list form for most_connected is preferred.
